name: Scout v4
title: Scout v4
note: Scout v4 shape design (8 Nov, Spark: new props, no Bee35, everything printed in PCTG, still seats in the landing funnel for the battery swapper): Gemfan 5125 props on a printed frame, a half cage on the new discs; the battery mechanism (receiver, cartridge, pack, 266 g) not drawn: it mounts on 4 M3 bolts. -160..160 x -160..160 x -19..134 mm, ~722 g (E). tools/scout_v4_shape.py

parts.name: frame v4, one body: deck, arms, motor pods, side lugs and the base (yokes, nose block, flow pod, tail tray) (generated, parts/scout_v4_frame)
parts.note: one print inside |x|, |y| 89.3 (the A1 mini's 180), deck-top down on the bed: deck z 18.5..24.5 and the yokes over the receiver down to its top 9.6, arms to O28 motor pads at (+-74.3, +-74.3), the battery mechanism's 4 M3 inserts, the FC's and the Radxa's posts, the XR2's, DRV8833's, UBEC's and flow sensor's lands, the 8 rod sockets (DN BN DT BT DS0 BS0 DS1 BS1), the turret's four insert bosses; the room until the run lands; PCTG

parts.name: probe camera: Arducam 12MP autofocus USB in its metal case (B0FLX58WKZ; bracket off)
parts.note: nods with the cradle about the SG90's axis from -20 to +90 deg; parked 15 deg up it is the front camera, lens (27, 0, 116), 61 x 50 deg, autofocus 10 cm to inf, 1080p 30 live, 12 MP stills; the case is its heat spreader (Spark 9 Nov); 36 square, depth 20 E: measure

parts.name: probe camera cradle (generated, parts/scout_v4_cradle)
parts.note: side pads, front lips and a back stop round the case, the horn's pad and the idler's insert; a TPU strap over the case (1 g); PCTG

parts.name: probe light: two 25 x 8 mm bars of Clearhill 5 V COB strip, 4000 K, CRI 90 (B0F1YPP6QS)
parts.note: stuck on the camera case's top and bottom fronts (the metal case is their heat sink; no fins), 25 mm is the strip's cut length; ~0.2 W a bar at 8 W/m; on the DRV8833's B channel, DC or PWM >= 20 kHz

parts.name: probe tilt servo: SG90 (DORHEA, B0DFKPVRC2) and its 470 uF capacitor
parts.note: its shaft on the tilt axis facing -y, held by its 32.8 tabs on the head frame's +y pads; the capacitor on its lead covers its > 1 A start

parts.name: probe head frame: the clip on the blades' tip, the SG90's pads, the idler's boss (generated, parts/scout_v4_head_frame)
parts.note: blade A held by an M2 across the clip, blade B in a +-3 slot; an M3 screw is the idler; PCTG

parts.name: probe turret: housing, throat, drum and the roof's middle node RM (PCTG, generated: parts/scout_v4_probe_turret)
parts.note: side plates the size of the spool and the drum, a 32 mm throat: 3 (thin walls), TPU lip 1, wires 1 (E); drawn see-through until the run lands

parts.name: probe spool, hub O20, with its 40 T gear (module 0.8) on an M3 screw
parts.note: hub O20 23.4 wide, flanges O29, the two 19 mm blades and the camera cable wound to ~O27; ~2.1 turns for the 150 mm roll-out; the blades' ends clamped in it, so fully out is a hard stop

parts.name: probe pinion, 12 T, on the N20's 3 mm D shaft
parts.note: centres 20.8 from the spool's (40 / 12); its bore D-shaped, 2.3 wall at the root (PCTG)

parts.name: N20 6 V 300 rpm gear motor, no encoder (Augiimor, B0BZDC951L)
parts.note: 37 long (can 17 x O12, 3 mm D shaft 10); under the spool and the drum facing +y, in a pocket through the deck (the base's room must keep it out, z 15.2 up); it runs out or in to a stall (the blades' anchor out, the head seated in); at 5 V ~250 rpm

parts.name: the head's cable, coiled loosely in the drum
parts.note: 6 thin conductors (the head carries the camera, the servo and the LED bars): 5 V and GND in 26 AWG (shared; the 470 uF at the servo covers its start), USB D+ / D- twisted, the servo's signal and the LED bars' switched minus in 30 AWG; a JST ZH 1.5 mm 4-pin lead into the camera; up between the blades, round the spool, 3.5 turns of room in the drum for ~2; the USB pair to the USB-C breakout on the Radxa

parts.name: the two blades from the spool up into the throat
parts.note: two 19 mm (3/4 in) steel tape strips, 0.2 m each with 0.15 m used, cut from one ordinary 3 m tape measure (its case and spring not used; 13 spare strips), curves facing (~22 g/m, E); ends set in printed clamp slots with epoxy (hardened steel: not drilled); their mass is all here

parts.name: probe mast, blade A (10 mm steel tape, curves facing)
parts.note: drawn 1 mm long above the throat; the page's timeline rolls it out to 150 mm and back (tools/scout_v4_timeline.py). Its mass is in the feed's

parts.name: probe mast, blade B (10 mm steel tape, curves facing)
parts.note: drawn 1 mm long above the throat; the page's timeline rolls it out to 150 mm and back (tools/scout_v4_timeline.py). Its mass is in the feed's

parts.name: FC MicoAir743 AIO (under the deck, over the receiver)
parts.note: 36 x 36 at x 15.5..51.5, z 10.0..20.5, component side up on 4 M3 posts down from the deck (grommets; heads from below with the receiver off); set its IMU offset in PX4 (EKF2_IMU_POS_X ~ +0.034 m)

parts.name: UBEC
parts.note: on the tail tray's tape land, across the drone (x -71.5..-54.5, |y| 30.5), under the Radxa

parts.name: XR2
parts.note: flat under its tape land beside the FC (+y)

parts.name: DRV8833 (KOOBOOK, B07S7Z8CFL)
parts.note: flat under its tape land beside the FC (-y): channel A the probe's N20, B its LED bars

parts.name: Radxa Zero 3W
parts.note: under the deck behind the turret's N20 on four M2.5 posts (inserts in the deck), 65 along x, its USB-C plugs out the -y edge

parts.name: flow MTF-02P
parts.note: the nose pod, turned 90 deg (outer edge x 70.5, bottom -19.1): set SENS_FLOW_ROT for the turn

parts.name: battery mount: 4 x M3 up from below into M3 x 5.7 heat-set inserts in the base's yokes (as the Overseer's)
parts.note: at (49.6, +-26.55) and (-36.4, +-26.55) through the receiver's O3.4 boss holes; M3 x 12 E (the boss's depth: measure); the inserts in O10 bosses of the yokes (wall >= 3), the heads reached from below with the cartridge out

parts.name: half cage v4, rods (3 mm carbon: the ring, the flat roof, end Vs and side fans)
parts.note: 32 rods, 3.40 m, every one 12 from the swept discs and none over or under a disc: ring at z 61 with flats at 155 (310 across), a flat roof (spine on y 0, hoop on x 0, nose / tail triangles), a V at each end and a fan at each side down to the bottom nodes, which hang on rod triangles to the deck's side lugs and tail (NB on the camera's mount)
